title: 고등법원 부장판사급 이상의 법관의 보직범위에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02768:20180108:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부장판사급 이상의 법관의 보직범위에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Supreme Court Rule No. 2768, January 8, 2018>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures)
A judge appointed before these Rules enter into force to a position of the rank of presiding judge of a high court or higher under the former provisions shall be deemed a judge of the rank of presiding judge of a high court or higher under the former provisions.
